blocks.text: Ezekiel 42 survives in multiple ancient textual witnesses including the Masoretic Text, the Old Greek translation (Iezekiel), Papyrus 967, Qumran fragments, and the Masada scroll. These witnesses show variations in wording and word order throughout the passage. The presence of these multiple traditions indicates that careful textual analysis at the passage level is necessary to understand how Ezekiel's vision of the temple chambers was preserved and transmitted in antiquity.
